panels.description: Falcon maintenance room: projected map labeled SCIENTIFIC DRILLING / ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING shows unauthorized branches descending toward resource markers. Leave wall space for labels.
Manifest beside concealed waste chute shows ICE CORE STORAGE overwritten over DRILL FLUID / RESIDUALS. Nayah photographs it; Sitara studies vibration traces. Leave upper third for dialogue.
Synchronized drilling-vibration and ice-motion displays share a red timestamp fragment handwritten across a maintenance sheet. Leave upper-left for dialogue.
TJ turns toward sealed archive slot holding paper records, dead data wafer, and warning fragment 07:14 / ———. Leave lower-left for dialogue.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: That is not an ice-core manifest.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: It is pretending to be one.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: The vibration is local. The instability is not.
